verdict: Paid ads have been dark 11 days; organic is holding but not enough.
narrative: Your Meta campaigns stopped running on August 7 and have generated zero leads since — compared to roughly 4 leads per day before that pause, the impact is material. The 50 leads and $1,267 in spend you see this period were all earned in the first half of the window, before activity went dark. Your Google Business Profile continued generating real demand — 57 calls and 168 total actions over the 28 days — but organic alone cannot replace paid volume. Campaigns are being reactivated this week, and you should expect lead flow to resume once they are back in market.
